hooks.statusMessage: Checking changed files for loose ends...
hooks.command:
bash -c '
CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null)
STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null)
ALL=$(printf "%s\n%s" "$CHANGED" "$STAGED" | sort -u | grep -v "^$" | grep -v "^\.claude/")

if [ -z "$ALL" ]; then exit 0; fi

ISSUES=""
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  HITS=$(grep -n "TODO\|FIXME\|HACK\|XXX\|not yet implemented\|throw NotImplementedError" "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  [ -n "$HITS" ] && ISSUES="${ISSUES}\n${f}:\n${HITS}"
done <<< "$ALL"

if [ -n "$ISSUES" ]; then
  printf "Loose ends found in changed files:\n%s\n\nRe-check the brief: is every acceptance criterion actually met? Did the tests you claimed to run actually pass — show evidence or re-run them. Address each TODO/stub above or explicitly confirm it is intentional and out of scope." "$ISSUES"
  exit 2
fi

exit 0
'
